info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Risk Model Update API
info.description: The Operational Risk Model Update API enables financial institutions to modify and enhance their operational risk models. This endpoint allows users to update specific model attributes related to risk assessment and management. Typical consumers include risk managers and data analysts who need to ensure that models reflect the latest regulatory requirements and organizational practices. By utilizing this API, organizations can maintain more accurate and compliant operational risk evaluations.

patch.summary: Update an existing operational risk model.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an operational risk model identified by its unique resource ID 'RES-100045'. You can modify various attributes of the model to ensure it reflects the most current data and analysis.
